xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5006: pan lane start --machine auto prints no reason when Auto picks this machine

plan.title: pan lane start --machine auto prints no reason when Auto picks this machine
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: pan lane start --machine auto prints Auto's reason only when Auto picks a linked machine. When Auto picks this machine, laneMachineResolver returns null (dropping target.reason), resolveTargetMachine never carried answer.rejections, and the result is machine: null like a plain local launch, so the operator cannot tell Auto ran or what it passed over.
narratives.Proposal: Carry Auto's explanation end to end as a new sibling field LaneLaunchResult.placement { label, reason, rejections }, set for any Auto pick (this machine or a linked one). FleetTarget gains optional rejections; resolveMachine returns RemoteLaneTarget | LocalLanePlacement | null; the route returns a LocalLanePlacement for a self Auto pick; the CLI prints the reason and a 'Passed over: …' line. machine keeps meaning null = runs here so the follower and stdout format are unchanged.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to pan worker run, pan start --machine or fleet conversation spawn output (they only gain an optional FleetTarget.rejections they ignore)
- No change when --machine is absent; resolveMachine stays uncalled on that path
- No change to LaneLaunchResult.machine's shape or meaning (null = runs here), the human stdout lane line, or pan lane list
- No change to the frontend lane feed (GauntletRunFeedCard)
- No change to placementReason() or noMachineFits() wording

autoDecisions.summary: Add a sibling LaneLaunchResult.placement field instead of putting the self pick into machine with self: true
autoDecisions.rationale: machine being non-null starts the remote-lane follower (lanes.ts line 209) and selects the 'on <label>' stdout format (lane.ts line 281); three tests assert machine null for local lanes. A sibling field changes none of them.

autoDecisions.summary: Print passed-over machines as a second stderr line 'Passed over: <label>: <reason>; …' for every Auto pick, local or remote
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for the rejections ideally; a separate line keeps placementReason() shared with workers unchanged, and printing it for remote picks too keeps one consistent rule.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep machine.reason for remote Auto picks and have the CLI read placement.reason ?? machine.reason
autoDecisions.rationale: A new CLI against an older dashboard still prints the reason, and the reason never prints twice.
